# MakiMate Pi Python dependencies — curated minimal list.
# Install into a venv (recommended) or system Python.
#
# Usage (venv):
#   python3 -m venv ~/maki_venv
#   source ~/maki_venv/bin/activate
#   pip install -r env/pi_requirements.txt
#
# Or system-wide (if colcon/ROS nodes need it without venv activation):
#   sudo /usr/bin/python3 -m pip install -r env/pi_requirements.txt --break-system-packages
